measured.cost_unit: decoded native x86-64 instruction bytes in complete wasm function disassembly, including prologue/epilogue/trap stubs; not CLIF cost or whole-AOT size

independent_artifact_audit: Downloaded both original GitHub CI ZIPs and matched SHA-256 against GitHub artifact digests
Inspected all 21 files in new artifact and checked WAT, AOT and disassembly SHA-256 receipts for every context and compiler
Independently tokenized hex-encoded machine instructions from all eight disassemblies and recovered every declared native-byte count
Recomputed all native-byte savings and DIV reductions without trusting reported deltas
Inspected incoming-live x86 code and observed input registers occupied through DIV and later consumed; no universal machine-state proof is implied
Examined original fixture: nominally pre-div local computations can be rescheduled after DIV, motivating the new ten-independent-argument fixture
CI ran real AOT guest calls with deterministic Python oracle and trap checks, then repeated them in audit mode

upstream_alignment.issue_description: Explicitly asks for udiv/urem deduplication on x86 and notes possible register-pressure tradeoff
upstream_alignment.proposed_upstream_approach: Multi-result udivrem instruction and target-aware egraph rules (not yet implemented by this experiment)

limits: Human-authored adjacent udiv/urem transformation, not newly synthesized candidate
Not a complete compiler-pass or x86 register, flags, ABI, poison/undefined, or trap refinement proof
Incoming eight arguments are used after division; bytecode and one disassembly show machine register pressure, not a proof for arbitrary register allocation or all target variants
The earlier pressure fixture is not proof of eight physical registers live through DIV because codegen can reorder its computations
One x86-64 target and one CI host; no cross-target safety conclusion
No representative workload throughput or overall compilation-profitability conclusion from this artifact
Artifact retention 30 days; persistent structured checkpoint pins the original audit inputs, but replay must use the test commit rather than the changing research branch tip
Do not merge to main/release or submit upstream until stronger compiler-pass/machine-state assurance and broader benchmarking
